- `خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ`: Ölçme (`خ ل ق:B001`) ve biçim (`B003`) yerel ilahî yaratmayı derinleştirir; uydurma söz (`B007`) aynı kelimenin yerel anlamı değil, `زَعَمْتُمْ` ile oluşan karşıtlık basıncıdır.
- `مَرَّةٍ`: Geçip gitme (`م ر ر:B001`) ve acılık (`B003/B004`) alanları envanterde korunur; tamlama yapısı burada sayılabilir oluşu (`B002`) seçer.
- `زَعَمْتُمْ`: Kefalet (`ز ع م:B003`) ironik basınç olarak taşınmıştır; yerel fiil şüpheli/dayanaksız iddiadır (`B001`).
- `لَكُمْ`: `word_analysis` ilişkisel yakınlık basıncı da kaydeder; prose yalnız güvenilir yerel işlevi, fiilin yönelttiği çoğul muhatap tamamlayıcısını kullanır.

## Karşı delil ve nitelendirmeler

- `İzlenebilir`: Etken kıraat varyantı, yaygın edilgen okuyuşu iptal eden bir alternatif olarak değil, ses-durum karşıtlığını görünür kılan varyant olarak işlendi (`E04`).
- `İzlenebilir nitelendirme`: 18:103-105, “hazır bulunma”yı “ağırlık taşıma”yla özdeşleştirmeye karşı canlı basınçtır; iki okuma prose içinde birlikte tutuldu (`E29`).
- `İzlenebilir sınır`: `مَالِ` için servet anlamı yerel çözüm değildir; servet yalnız sûre-içi ses ve tema basıncı olarak korundu (`E12`).

## Karşı Kayıtlar

- `inter_ayah_rows[18:53]` satırı, ateşi görme sahnesini odak âyetin mesel ve tartışma teması için “no value” sayar. Buna karşılık zorunlu word-analysis konuları `18:54:1:inter-struct`, `18:54:4:inter-struct` ve `18:54:10:inter-struct` 18:53 ile sınır bağlantısını açıkça kurar. Prose bu gerilimi, önceki sahnenin ayrıntılarından bir tema çıkarmayıp yalnız “kaçışsız sonuçtan açıklamaya geçiş” düzeyinde tutarak korudu.
- Bundle'da bunun dışında yerel okumayı zorlayan açık bir karşı-delil kaydı yoktur. `no value` etiketli diğer inter-ayah satırları geri getirme yükümlülüğü taşımayan retrieval kayıtları olarak aparatta saklıdır ve prose'a çevrilmemiştir.

## Karşı Kanıt ve Kanal Sınırı

Bundle, bu ayetin yerel okumalarına karşı açık bir karşı kanıt kaydetmiyor. `channel_subchannels_anchored_here` iki bağlantı adayı sağlıyor; bunlar tek okurlu ilk geçiş incelemesi olduğu, kabul/red veya olgunluk kaydı taşımadığı için prose’da kurulmuş sure kanalları olarak adlandırılmadı. Zulüm, helâk ve tayin arasındaki bağlantı yalnız ayetin kendi kelimelerinden kuruldu. Yerleşim düzeninin yerinden çıkması ve hesabın yönetilen vakti ifadeleri yukarıdaki tabloda yazar çıkarımı olarak ayrıca işaretlendi.

## Counter-Evidence And Containment

- The later explanation in 18:80-81 supplies future parental pressure and replacement, which is information absent from 18:74. It is retained in P31 as counter-pressure against treating Musa’s visible life-for-life measure as exhaustive; it does not erase the locally explicit purity claim or the moral force of the protest.
- The wide reader walk activates non-recognition only after 18:78-79 begins interpretation of the earlier act. P32 marks this as inference and preserves both live readings: `نُكْرًۭا` is a severe condemned act in the visible frame (`ن ك ر/B003`, `B006`) and an act not yet recognized under incomplete information (`B001`).
- Narrowed branches are sentence-contained: release behind departure (`ط ل ق/B001`, `B003`), fate/receiving behind encounter (`ل ق ي/B007`, `B011`), desire behind the youth noun (`غ ل م/B002`), growth behind purity (`ز ك و/B001`), alteration behind absence (`غ ي ر/B003`), arrival behind act-production (`ج ي ء/B001`, `B004`), willing behind thinghood (`ش ي ء/B001`), and non-recognition beside moral rejection (`ن ك ر/B001`, `B003`, `B006`). None replaces the local grammatical selection.
**Sınır:** “Yeni çocuk” adı yüzeyde söylenmez; `خَيْرًا` belirsiz sıfatı, bağlamdan anlaşılan kişiyi üstlenir. Prose bunu “birini” diye açar.

## Karşı delil ve sınırlar

- `سَبَبًا` için yerel seçim `root_000664/B003` bağlantı ve erişimdir. `B001` kesme ve `B002` sövme yerel anlam olarak seçilmemiş, topic `18:84:11:cut-connect-tension` uyarınca karşı baskı olarak korunmuştur.
- `كُلِّ` için yerel seçim `root_001315/B003` bütünlüktür. Topic `18:84:9:consumption-derivation-blocked`, tüketme bağlantısını yerel dilbilgisinin dışına alır.
- `شَىْءٍ` için sözlük girdisi bundle’da yoktur; QAC morfolojisi ve word-analysis topicleri yerel “şey/kategori” işini destekler. İrade bağlantısı topic `18:84:10:will-linked-entity-pressure` uyarınca ikincil baskı olarak tutulmuştur.
- Yeryüzü alanı, topic `18:84:5:terrestrial-not-heavenly` uyarınca göksel ve sınırsız yetki okumasını sınırlar; 40:36-37 yalnız karşılaştırmalı arka plandır.

# Karşı-Delil ve Sınırlar

- `ق و ل`: Yerel `قَالَ`, `root_001272/B001` seslendirilmiş sözdür. `B005` asılsız isnat, `B009` karşılıklı müzakere, `B012` iç söz, `B013` kanaat/mezhep ve `B014` sözsüz delalet bu Form I tamamlanmış konuşma eyleminin yerel anlamı yapılmadı.
- `ظ ل م`: `root_000967/B004` ile `B008` yer/zaman dışına koyma ve esirgeme basıncı verir. `B003` mağdurun şikâyet ve giderim araması, nesnesiz etken `ظَلَمَ`nın yerel rolü yapılmadı.
- `ع ذ ب`: `root_000994/B005` iki fiili ve `عَذَابًا`yı cezalandırma alanında birleştirir. `B001` tatlı su, `B002` yeme içmeden kesilme, `B003` alıkoyma, `B004` göğe açık olma, `B006` sarkan uç ve diğer somut dallar ayrı kök dalları olarak korundu; yerel cezayı ikame etmedi.
- `ر د د`: Edilgen fiil + `إِلَىٰ` hedefi `root_000555/B001` geri gönderilmeyi seçer. `B002-B003` geri çevirme/reddetme ve `B010` tekrar/tereddüt basınçtır; kişinin kendi kendine dönmesi veya döngüsel hareket diye sunulmadı.
- `ر ب ب`: `root_000532/B001` Rablik, sahiplik ve yetki yerel addır. `B002` bakım ve aşama aşama yetiştirme ilişkiyi renklendirir; burada yeni bir yetiştirme fiili kurmaz.
- `ن ك ر`: Yerel sıfat `root_001550/B003` ve tanınmanın karşıtı olan `B001` ile açıklanmıştır. `B002` kurnazlık, `B004` tanınmaz hâle getirme eylemi, `B005` bedensel akıntı, `B006` engellenen çirkin fiil ve `B007` düşmanlık/çatışma yerel sıfatın yerine geçirilmedi.

## Karşı-Delil Ve Sınırlama

- `دُونِهَا` mekânsal/koruyucu ilişkide tutuldu. `18:90:15:recording-derivative-overreach` topic'i reddedilmiştir: kayıt ve dokümantasyon türevleri (`root_000502/B005`) kaynak öbeği, güneş eki ve örtü nesnesi tarafından engellenir (`QS-5d47afc1`, `MS-9fa7be6b`).
- `سِتْرًا` fiziksel koruyucu örtü olarak tutuldu. `18:90:16:theological-attribute-overreach` topic'i reddedilmiştir: ilahî gizleyici rahmetin yokluğuna dair iddia, yerel nesne ile olumsuz sağlama cümlesinin sınırını aşar (`MS-a919d723`).
- Küçük genizsel bağlanma ses notu `18:90:14:sound-filler`, kaynak/koruma getirisini tekrarladığı için upstream'de `dropped_filler` olmuştur (`QP-d8e83f77`); prose yükümlülüğü doğurmaz.
- Kök dalları yalnız sınırlanmış baskı olarak kullanıldı. Somut varış, fiziksel güneş, algısal bulma, insan topluluğu, amaçlı sağlama, mekânsal ilişki ve koruyucu örtme baştan sona yerel seçim olarak kaldı.

**Karşı-delil / containment:** Yerel yapı Form X kapasite fiilidir. Obedience/compliance dalı yerel anlamın yerine geçirilmemiş, nesnenin müdahaleye cevap vermeyişini düşündüren daraltılmış basınç olarak tutulmuştur.
**Karşı-delil / containment:** Prose, “galip gelmek”i yerel çeviri yapmaz. Doğrudan nesne eki fiziksel surmounting’i seçer; dominance yalnız aynı hareketin ikincil yankısıdır.

**Karşı-delil / containment:** `inter_ayah_rows` 5:12’yi barrier sense için “no value” sayar. Prose bu referansı fiziksel breach desteği olarak kullanmaz; aynı kökün temsilci dalına ne kadar uzaklaşabildiğini gösteren karşıt örnek olarak kullanır. 50:36 da constructed-boundary açıklaması değil, passage/search basıncıdır.

**Sınır:** Bu bağlantı kurulmuş bir surah channel’ı veya maturity iddiası değildir. `channel_subchannels_anchored_here` yalnız first-pass single-reader malzemedir; prose, channel adını ya da surah tezini ileri sürmez.

## Karşı Delil ve Sınırlar

- `ٱلَّذِينَ` için varyant sözdizimi zamiri nesne yönünde yeniden kurabilir; standart QAC ve word-analysis onu `حَسِبَ` fiilinin öznesi olarak tutar. Prose bu standart yerel kuruluşu verir, varyantı doğruluk yarışına sokmaz. Dayanak: `18:102:3:form`.
- `حَسِبَ` için görme/hitap ve yeterlik yönleri varyant veya kök-alanı karşıtlığıdır. Yerel fiil “sanmak” olarak korunmuş, hesap basıncı onun içinde taşınmıştır. Dayanak: `18:102:2:semantic`, `18:102:2:form`; `root_000318/B001-B003`.
- `يَتَّخِذُوا۟` için geçmiş zaman veren okuyuşlar kayıtlıdır. Standart biçim QAC'de `IMPF`, Form VIII ve `SUBJ` olarak çözülür; prose varyantı yalnız standart bağımlılığı keskinleştirmek için kullanır. Dayanak: `18:102:6:form`.
- `دُونِىٓ` alanındaki “sicile kaydetme” (`root_000502/B005`) uzak ve kalıplaşmış bir daldır. Yerel dışlama `B001/B003` ile taşınır; sicil dalı yerel anlam yapılmamıştır.
- `جَهَنَّمَ` çevresindeki derinlik ve ateş çağrışımları özel adın doğrudan nesne oluşunu ikame etmez. Dayanak: `18:102:13:semantic`.
- `أَعْتَدْنَا` split-root eşlemesinde `root_000989` baskın hedef, `root_000978` ikincil hedeftir; sıralama doğruluk sıralaması olarak kullanılmadı. Yerel “hazırladık” iki hedefte de desteklenirken sayma basıncı yalnız `root_000989/B001` üzerinden eklendi.
- `channel_subchannels_anchored_here` adjudike bir ledger değildir. E18'deki hesap-hazırlık ve sahte koruyucu-hakiki karşılama bağlantıları kanal adı veya sûre çapında olgunluk iddiası olarak sunulmadı; açıkça yazar çıkarımı işaretlendi.

## Counter-Evidence And Containment

- The plus/minus-five reader walk’s “apparent bulk collapses into zero weight” reading is anchored in `ح ب ط/B001`, but `v12_cross_run_publication.findings[1]` grades its compact publication form `reject`. P09 and P20 retain the lexical swelling image as a contained pressure inside the explicit deed-nullification sense; they do not publish the rejected finding as an established causal model.
- `لِقَآئِهِۦ` keeps two genitive directions live: their meeting Him and His meeting them. P07 states both and preserves the locally governing denial frame.
- The variant topics for `حَبِطَتْ` and `نُقِيمُ` nominate aspect, sound, and agency contrasts without inlining the actual variant forms. P10 and P14 therefore state only the bounded contrast supplied by the bundle and keep the canonical QAC surfaces controlling.
- The scale-instrument branch `و ز ن/B002` remains a valid field resonance and is supported by 7:8-9, 21:47, and 101:6-8. The local noun is `وَزْنًۭا`, “weight/value,” supported especially by `B001` and `B007`; P18 corrects the likely instrument-for-object misconception without suppressing the scale field.
- Channel material is first-pass and unadjudicated. P22 is explicitly marked inference and connects only words present in 18:105; no established surah channel, maturity, or surah thesis is asserted.

**Counter-evidence:** The return/pausing pressure is preserved only as a background association nominated by `18:106:9:marker-and-return-pressure`; the local plural object selects divine signs/verses/proofs. The recitational compression changes sound surface while preserving possession and object role.

**Counter-evidence:** The bundle preserves a real `ḥāl` analysis, while local double-object valency supports the end-state analysis. Both are rendered; the latter grounds the paragraph. Accepted sound variants alter texture, not semantic or grammatical role.

reviewedChannels.text:
# S018 Semantic Channel Discovery

## Parent Channels

### 1. Straightened Transmission and Conduct
- Semantic invariant: A communication becomes trustworthy when deviation is removed from its form and its recipients are prepared to follow a sound course.
- Surface relation: direct; 18:1-2 presents an unwarped book, while 18:10 and 18:14-17, 18:24 distribute preparation, heart-binding, proof, and right guidance within the same pericope.
- Surprising reach: Straightness migrates from the shape of revelation into the posture of hearts and the practical route they seek.

#### Subchannel A. An Unwarped Book Carries Warning and Promise
- Reading type: surface-primary
- Scene or process: Revelation descends as an organized book whose semantic crookedness has been removed, allowing it to warn and announce recompense.
- Active motifs: organized writing `ك ت ب:B002/m01`; revelatory descent `ن ز ل:B002/m01`; semantic deviation `ع و ج:B002/m01`; upright equilibrium `ق و م:B008/m01`; caution-awakening warning `ن ذ ر:B001/m01`; joy-opening announcement `ب ش ر:B005/m01`; intentional action `ع م ل:B001/m01`; earned recompense `ء ج ر:B001/m01`
- Ayah anchors: 18:1 (the descended book and denial of crookedness); 18:2 (upright warning, good news, good works, and reward)
- Synthesis: The book is not merely called true. Its internal alignment is presented as the enabling condition for two directed effects: danger becomes legible, and faithful action receives a determinate outcome.

#### Subchannel B. Prepared Hearts Find the Sound Course
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Petition, divine stabilization, proof, and guidance repeatedly convert vulnerable interior states into a practicable direction.
- Active motifs: heart-binding `ر ب ط:B004/m01`; heart-intellect `ق ل ب:B001/m01`; straight route `ر ش د:B001/m01`; sound handling of an affair `ر ش د:B002/m01`; gentle direction `ه د ي:B001/m01`; practical preparation `ه ي ء:B002/m01`; unjust deviation `ش ط ط:B002/m01`; compelling proof `س ل ط:B002/m01`
- Ayah anchors: 18:10 (prepared guidance); 18:14-15 (hearts bound against an outrageous claim and the demand for proof); 18:17 (divine guidance); 18:24 (hope for a nearer sound course)
- Synthesis: Guidance here is engineered readiness rather than abstract information. The heart is held firm, an affair is made workable, and deviant speech is tested by whether it possesses compelling warrant.

### 2. Controlled Permeability at the Cave
- Semantic invariant: Refuge works by regulating passage across a boundary: persons enter, mercy and light reach them selectively, and hostile access is repelled.
- Surface relation: direct; 18:10, 18:16-18 repeatedly stage the cave as a threshold with differentiated inward and outward movement.
- Surprising reach: The cave is neither sealed nor simply open; it behaves as a selectively permeable shelter.

#### Subchannel A. Withdrawal Opens an Interior Field of Mercy
- Reading type: surface-primary
- Scene or process: Separation from the surrounding people becomes movement into a refuge where mercy can spread and the difficult affair can be made serviceable.
- Active motifs: lateral withdrawal `ع ز ل:B001/m01`; joining a refuge `ء و ي:B001/m01`; broad cave `ك ه ف:B001/m01`; sheltering refuge `ك ه ف:B002/m01`; tender mercy `ر ح م:B001/m01`; practical preparation `ه ي ء:B002/m01`; opening and spreading `ن ش ر:B001/m01`; usable facility `ر ف ق:B003/m01`; straight route `ر ش د:B001/m01`
- Ayah anchors: 18:10 (taking refuge and asking for prepared guidance); 18:16 (withdrawal, entry into the cave, spreading mercy, and facilitating the affair)
- Synthesis: Physical retreat is the first operation, not the final state. The enclosed place becomes productive because mercy is spread within it and the fugitives' affair is reorganized into a viable course.

#### Subchannel B. Light Passes Without Violating the Shelter
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: The sun's approach and departure are spatially deflected so that illumination passes around occupants held in the cave's open interior.
- Active motifs: solar body `ش م س:B001/m01`; luminary rising `ط ل ع:B001/m01`; inclined deviation `ز و ر:B001/m01`; western setting `غ ر ب:B006/m01`; side-cutting passage `ق ر ض:B002/m01`; right side `ي م ن:B002/m01`; left side `ش م ل:B006/m01`; broad interior gap `ف ج و:B001/m01`; broad cave `ك ه ف:B001/m01`
- Ayah anchors: 18:17 (sunrise, sunset, right and left passage, and the occupants in the cave's opening)
- Synthesis: Protection is achieved through routing rather than total exclusion. The light remains active, but its trajectory is made compatible with the sleepers' preservation.

#### Subchannel C. The Threshold Converts Looking into Flight
- Reading type: surface-primary
- Scene or process: The dog occupies the entrance while an approaching observer is allowed only a glimpse before terror reverses the approach.
- Active motifs: guarding dog `ك ل ب:B001/m01`; spatial extension `ب س ط:B001/m01`; outstretched forelimb `ب س ط:B004/m01`; arm-span `ذ ر ع:B001/m01`; forecourt threshold `و ص د:B002/m01`; peering access `ط ل ع:B003/m01`; turning away `و ل ي:B007/m01`; rapid flight `ف ر ر:B001/m01`; filling to capacity `م ل ء:B001/m01`; engulfing terror `ر ع ب:B001/m01`
- Ayah anchors: 18:18 (the dog at the threshold, the observer's look, reversal, flight, and terror)
- Synthesis: The scene gives the cave an active defensive edge. A stretched body marks the boundary, and attempted visual access triggers an immediate counter-movement away from it.

### 3. Suspension Turned into Measure
- Semantic invariant: A period of immobilized awareness becomes knowable only when awakening converts duration into comparison, number, and dispute.
- Surface relation: direct; 18:11-12, 18:18-19, and 18:25 place induced sleep, reanimation, and temporal reckoning in one pericope.
- Surprising reach: Awakening does not simply restore activity; it produces the epistemic problem by which hidden time can be measured.

#### Subchannel A. Hearing Is Withheld While Bodies Remain
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: An imposed restraint reaches the ears, consciousness enters sleep, and bodies persist in a state that resembles wakefulness without ordinary reception.
- Active motifs: imposed restraint `ض ر ب:B004/m01`; ear as receptive opening `ء ذ ن:B001/m01`; sleeping stillness `ر ق د:B001/m01`
- Ayah anchors: 18:11 (restraint upon the ears for numbered years); 18:18 (sleeping bodies appearing awake)
- Synthesis: Suspension is organized through the sensory gate most closely tied to receiving a call. The bodies remain visibly present while the channel that would reconnect them to surrounding time is held closed.

#### Subchannel B. Awakening Makes Elapsed Time Countable
- Reading type: surface-primary
- Scene or process: The sleepers are stirred so that competing estimates of their stay can expose who can count its furthest term.
- Active motifs: stirring from stillness `ب ع ث:B001/m01`; exhaustive counting `ح ص ي:B002/m01`; enumeration `ع د د:B001/m01`; temporal endpoint `ء م د:B001/m01`; extended stay `ل ب ث:B001/m01`; year-duration `س ن و:B008/m01`; nine-count `ت س ع:B001/m01`; three-count `ث ل ث:B001/m01`; hundred-count `م ء ي:B002/m01`; discriminating knowledge `ع ل م:B001/m01`
- Ayah anchors: 18:11-12 (numbered years, awakening, and comparison of duration); 18:19 (mutual questioning about the stay); 18:25 (three hundred years increased by nine)
- Synthesis: The hidden interval is reconstructed through arithmetic and rival judgment. Counting is therefore not incidental chronology but the operation that makes suspended experience publicly contestable.

### 4. Recovering Absence Through Durable Traces
- Semantic invariant: What is no longer immediately present can be recovered when absence leaves an ordered mark that can be read backward.
- Surface relation: indirect; pericopes spanned: 1 (18:1-26) and 4 (18:60-82); bridge: the inscription and narrative traces of 18:6, 18:9, 18:13 and the retraced fish-path of 18:61-64 share a durable-mark retrieval operation.
- Surprising reach: A written memorial and a fugitive path perform the same retrieval function at different scales.

#### Subchannel A. Inscription and Narrative Preserve the Vanished Scene
- Reading type: latent/lexical
- Scene or process: The departed youths persist through effects, inscription, signs, and a sequential retelling that makes their absence intelligible.
- Active motifs: lasting trace `ء ث ر:B003/m01`; inscribed record `ر ق م:B001/m01`; visible sign `ء ي ي:B003/m01`; sequential narration `ق ص ص:B002/m01`
- Ayah anchors: 18:6 (grief over their receding traces); 18:9 (the cave and the inscription among the signs); 18:13 (their account narrated in sequence)
- Synthesis: The episode opens by treating disappearance as something that leaves readable residue. Record and narration stabilize what direct observation can no longer hold.

#### Subchannel B. Forgotten Loss Is Reversed by Following Its Track
- Reading type: surface-primary
- Scene or process: A forgotten fish becomes locatable when recovered memory prompts a return along the travelers' own footprints to the point of escape.
- Active motifs: memory lapse `ن س ي:B001/m01`; recovered recollection `ذ ك ر:B003/m01`; return to a prior point `ر د د:B001/m01`; following a trace `ء ث ر:B004/m01`; stepwise tracking `ق ص ص:B001/m01`; directed seeking `ب غ ي:B001/m01`; extended path `س ب ل:B001/m01`; fish `ح و ت:B001/m01`; tunnel-like passage `س ر ب:B002/m01`; seeping aquatic passage `س ر ب:B003/m01`; open water `ب ح ر:B001/m01`
- Ayah anchors: 18:61 (the forgotten fish takes its path into the sea); 18:62-63 (the loss and its cause are recalled); 18:64 (the travelers return by following their traces)
- Synthesis: Retrieval begins only after forgetting itself becomes legible. Memory identifies the lost junction, and the visible route permits motion to be reversed with precision.

### 5. Unsupported Speech as Physical Force
- Semantic invariant: Speech detached from knowledge is rendered as a bodily or mechanical act that exits, strikes, twists, or removes footing.
- Surface relation: indirect; pericopes spanned: 1 (18:1-26) and 3 (18:45-59); bridge: 18:4-5, 18:22, and 18:54-56 share the physicalization of unwarranted assertion as extrusion, projectile conjecture, and destabilizing contest.
- Surprising reach: The surah tests claims not only by truth value but by the kind of force their utterance applies.

#### Subchannel A. An Unknown Claim Protrudes from the Mouth
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: A claim lacking knowledge is pictured as something large that crosses the mouth's boundary and enters the shared world.
- Active motifs: speaking mouth `ف و ه:B003/m01`; emergence from enclosure `خ ر ج:B001/m01`; connected speech `ك ل م:B001/m01`; unsupported attribution `ق و ل:B005/m01`; fabricated falsehood `ك ذ ب:B001/m01`; discriminating knowledge `ع ل م:B001/m01`
- Ayah anchors: 18:4-5 (the attributed son, absence of knowledge, and the enormity of the word leaving their mouths)
- Synthesis: The utterance is judged through its origin and trajectory. Because no knowledge stands behind it, its emergence is a hazardous extrusion rather than responsible communication.

#### Subchannel B. Conjecture Stones What Cannot Be Seen
- Reading type: surface-primary
- Scene or process: Rival number claims are thrown toward an unseen matter and are restrained by limited disputation and refusal to solicit further estimates.
- Active motifs: injurious verbal stoning `ر ج م:B002/m01`; conjectural stoning of the unseen `ر ج م:B004/m01`; hidden domain `غ ي ب:B001/m01`; sharpened disputation `م ر ي:B003/m01`; unsettled doubt `م ر ي:B004/m01`; enumeration `ع د د:B001/m01`
- Ayah anchors: 18:22 (competing counts, stoning at the unseen, and restriction of dispute and inquiry)
- Synthesis: Number does not become evidence merely by being asserted. The image of stoning exposes estimates as projectiles launched where sight and knowledge do not reach.

#### Subchannel C. Twisted Dispute Tries to Make Truth Lose Its Footing
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Repeatedly varied signs meet a tightly wound argument whose purpose is to slide stable truth away and replace warning with mockery.

### 17. Speech Is Licensed by Source and Sequence

- Surprising reach: Restraint does not terminate speech; it assigns each kind of speech to a warranted source and moment.

#### Subchannel A. Hidden Matters and Future Acts Limit Assertion
- Reading type: mixed
- Scene or process: Claims about divine kinship and unseen counts fail for lack of knowledge, while future-directed speech is redirected through remembered dependence.
- Active motifs: unsupported attribution `ق و ل:B005/m01`; connected speech `ك ل م:B001/m01`; discriminating knowledge `ع ل م:B001/m01`; conjectural stoning of the unseen `ر ج م:B004/m01`; hidden domain `غ ي ب:B001/m01`; sharpened disputation `م ر ي:B003/m01`; recovered recollection `ذ ك ر:B003/m01`
- Ayah anchors: 18:4-5 (claim without knowledge); 18:22 (unseen count, constrained dispute, and inquiry); 18:23-24 (future assertion qualified by remembered dependence)
- Synthesis: The pericope distinguishes speaking from warrant. Neither confidence, numerical form, nor temporal intention can substitute for access to what the claim concerns.

#### Subchannel B. Questions Wait Until the Informed Guide Reports
- Reading type: surface-primary

- Ayah anchors: 18:67-70 (impatience, incomplete knowledge, and deferred questioning); 18:78, 18:82 (initiated interpretation and final disclosure)

#### Subchannel C. Unalterable and Inexhaustible Words Ground Finite Human Speech
- Reading type: mixed

### 18. Boundaries Are Judged by the Traffic They Control

- Reading type: mixed

### 19. Sound Action Outlasts Adornment and Transfers Benefit
- Semantic invariant: Displayed value is tested by whether it yields a durable good that survives attention, possession, generation, rule, and final reception.

#### Subchannel A. Earthly Adornment Is Installed as a Test of Action
- Reading type: surface-primary
- Scene or process: The earth's displayed beauty is made into an instrument for revealing which actors produce the better deed.
- Active motifs: displayed adornment `ز ي ن:B002/m01`; revealing test `ب ل و:B002/m01`; intentional action `ع م ل:B001/m01`; beneficial excellence `ح س ن:B002/m01`
- Ayah anchors: 18:7 (earthly adornment, testing, and comparison of action)

#### Subchannel B. The Gaze Must Not Trade Enduring Company for Display
- Reading type: mixed

#### Subchannel D. A Father's Soundness Protects Benefit Across a Generation

### 20. Following Is Judged by Its Object and Endpoint

- Reading type: surface-primary

### 23. Supposition Is Defeated by Exhaustive Accounting

- Reading type: mixed

### 24. A Fixed Promise Ends Temporary Arrangements
